items.title: Alibaba's Qwen4-Max takes on Opus 5.5, GPT-6, and Kimi K3.1 Pro at much lower prices
items.summary: Alibaba launches Qwen4-Max, a new flagship model with 2.4 trillion parameters that activates only 71 billion per token. A hybrid architecture sharply cuts costs on long contexts. Qwen4-Max lands just behind Kimi K3.1 Pro on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, and Alibaba plans to release smaller Qwen4 models as open source. items.title: Anthropic says the key to agent memory is knowing what to forget, not how much to store
items.summary: Anthropic studied how Claude retains knowledge across sessions. Selective notes beat exhaustive archives by a wide margin. In a Pokémon Red test, the newer Claude Fable 5 got four times as far as the older Sonnet 3.7 by keeping just a handful of strategy files instead of more than 400. items.title: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images, it paints them
items.summary: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images the way other AI models do. Instead of computing pixels, the language model writes Python code that places hundreds of thousands of simulated brushstrokes on a virtual canvas, complete with bristle texture and paint application. items.title: Firm linked to Jensen Huang's ex-lover reportedly brokered nearly $12 billion in Nvidia chip orders for China
items.summary: Megaspeed, the firm owned by ousted Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's former lover Alice Huang, arranged nearly $12 billion in Nvidia chip orders for Chinese companies between 2024 and 2025, according to the WSJ. Short seller Culper Research estimates Nvidia's actual China revenue share exceeds 20 percent, far above the officially reported 7 percent. items.title: Australia's central bank finds AI hitting young workers first, especially in software and customer service
items.summary: Australia's central bank sees early signs that AI is hitting young entry-level workers in highly exposed jobs like software development and customer service. Since ChatGPT launched, job postings and employment among 15- to 24-year-olds in those fields have dropped more sharply than among older workers. items.title: Meituan releases a 1.6-trillion-parameter agent model that never touched an Nvidia GPU
items.summary: Meituan has released the weights for LongCat-2.5, a 1.6-trillion-parameter model built for AI agents and trained entirely on Chinese hardware. On Terminal Bench, it scores 88.4 points, landing just behind Claude Opus 5. The sample deployment runs on 194 Huawei Ascend chips, and Meituan makes no mention of Nvidia GPUs. items.title: Anthropic CEO Amodei admits "there's a huge uncertainty in what's going to happen next year" days before a record IPO
items.summary: Days before what could be the largest IPO in history, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei called buying compute 'the deepest business dilemma' his company faces. Anthropic's commitments now total nearly $901 billion, and it's still far from clear whether future revenue will justify those costs. items.title: Gemini 4 Carbon takes the MathArena crown but costs 15 times more than GPT-6.1 Sol
items.summary: For the first time in a while, no OpenAI model leads the MathArena AI math benchmark. Google's Gemini 4 Carbon and Anthropic's Fable 5.2 have knocked GPT-6.1 Sol from the top, though both cost significantly more. Gemini ignored the time limit in testing and almost never gave up on a task. items.title: Anthropic says outdated prompting habits are slowing down Claude Opus 5.5
items.summary: Anthropic has made Claude Opus 5.5 the default model on all paid plans and published a guide that does away with old prompting habits.
